status: local amendment fixed before the new target-outcome comparison; root protocol receipt required before evaluation
known_outcomes: All original TRACE and neural-validation-v3 target outcomes are already known. This is a new retrospective comparison with decisions fixed before its new outcome join, not a new outcome-blind study or public preregistration.
features: two-column sealed binary probabilities [1-p,p]; explicit probability-space neighborhoods instead of the original CWE token features
binary_repair: Expand sklearn label_binarize's single binary column to [1-y,y] only when exactly two classes are declared; all official multiclass paths remain unchanged.
official_p_value_behavior: Retain the actual upstream globally pooled selected-neighbor conformity scores, including repetition across test rows. Do not replace them by independent per-row local p-values.
transductive_batch_boundary: One entire source model-validation role for selection, and one entire target project for each sealed deployment decision. No computational chunking of the neighborhood pool. Target feature distribution affects globally pooled p-values, but target labels remain inaccessible.

selection.objective: maximum error-detection F1 across official vulnerability-case-study LAC/APS/RAPS and their conservative union at every fixed alpha; top_k and the four-expert union are secondary
tie_break: expert order lac, aps, raps, mixture
selection.difference_from_upstream: The official case study's target-best-F1 reporting is replaced by source-only selection. The joint scalar-alpha grid is an explicit task adaptation, not unchanged original expert-selection logic.

accepted_action: Use original detector argmax when singleton prediction set and official p-value > 1-alpha; otherwise review. Primary mixture accepts only if LAC/APS/RAPS all accept; the four-expert union is secondary.
controls: global MSP at PROM automation count
disjoint probability tails at PROM safe and vulnerable automatic-label counts
source isotonic cost at PROM automation count for miss cost 10 and 50
source isotonic free-volume cost for miss cost 10 and 50
sealed v3 weighted primary alpha_v=0.10 alpha_s=0.20 clip=20

cost.review_accuracy_assumption: correct review; illustrative relative units, not measured analyst cost

statistics.unit: project after averaging actual fitted detector seeds
statistics.intervals: descriptive pointwise project bootstrap percentile intervals; no equivalence or general-superiority interpretation

whole_system_not_reproduced: original 8-way CWE case-study neural models and taxonomy
target-feedback acquisition and incremental neural-model retraining
stopping: Execute the predeclared complete sealed cohorts and fitted-seed grid once; retain failures and unfavorable results; do not choose subsets or retune using new target outcomes. Native multiclass checks are software-fidelity evidence only.
